title: Drude and two-pole Lorentz slabs: complex R, T and absorption against TMM with the same analytic permittivity; fitting error and ADE time-discretization error separated

fixture.engine: torchfdtd.Simulation with the passive trapezoidal ADE (MaterialADE), 2D normal incidence, y periodic, staircase Yee sampling, courant_factor 0.99, precision float64 on CPU

materials.name: G3-03 Drude
materials.expected_at_1p55um: eps about -1.70 + 0.22 i, skin depth about 0.20 um, so the 0.1 um slab is partially transmitting

materials.name: G3-03 Lorentz two-pole
materials.permittivity: eps_inf + sum_j A_j / (w0_j^2 - w^2 - i gamma_j w)
materials.expected_at_1p55um: eps about 2.93 + 0.13 i between the two resonances (0.99 um and 2.51 um)

fixture.slab_faces: centered at x = 0.0025 um (h20/8) at both meshes so that no Yee sample lies on a face; Drude 5 (h20) or 10 (h10) cells thick, Lorentz 25 or 50 cells

source.note: three-cycle Gaussian at 193.4 THz with the C1 endpoint taper; a fixed-k_parallel sheet at 45 deg is grazing beyond 1.55/sin(45 deg) = 2.19 um, where three cycles leave 2.5e-7 of the peak amplitude (one cycle would leave 17 percent and a non-decaying grazing residual); amplitude 1; soft sheet

frequencies.spacing: uniform in frequency from c/1.8 um to c/1.3 um

fixture.part_a: analytic materials given directly, both meshes, both polarizations

part_b.description: the analytic permittivity sampled to n/k at 61 wavelengths from 1.2 to 1.9 um, fitted with torchfdtd.fit_material (FitOptions max_poles=4, include_drude=True, tolerance=1e-3, wavelength_range_um=[1.2, 1.9], target=analytic, seed 0); the slab is rerun with the fitted material at h20, TE; three comparisons: FDTD(fitted) vs TMM(fitted eps) (discretization only), TMM(fitted) vs TMM(analytic) (fit only), FDTD(fitted) vs TMM(analytic) (total)

part_c.description: constitutive error of the trapezoidal ADE at the 21 band frequencies for the two time steps dt(h20) and dt(h10): the bilinear response eps_ADE(w) = eps_exact((2/dt) tan(w dt/2)) written in the test against eps_exact(w); the solver permittivity(material, f, dt) is checked against the bilinear formula; a directly driven single MaterialADE cell is checked against the bilinear prediction at f = 1/(128 dt) (h20) and 1/(256 dt) (h10), 167.3 THz

reference_method: TMM (Fresnel/Airy) as in G3-02 with complex eps and kx2 = sqrt(eps k0^2) taken with positive imaginary part; A_tmm = 1 - |r|^2 - |t|^2; analytic permittivity and the bilinear ADE response written in the test; no solver code in the oracles

observables.name: A_abs_error
observables.definition: max over the band of |(1 - R_fdtd - T_fdtd) - (1 - R_tmm - T_tmm)|

observables.name: t_phase_error
observables.definition: max over the band where |t_tmm| > 0.1 of |arg(t_fdtd / t_tmm)| (Yee-corrected)

observables.name: fit_error_on_band
observables.definition: fit report analytic normalized_rms, max_abs_n_error, max_abs_k_error on 1.2 to 1.9 um, plus max |n| and |k| errors on the 21 band samples computed in the test

observables.name: ade_constitutive_error
observables.definition: max over the band of |n_ADE - n_exact| and |k_ADE - k_exact| for each dt; ratio between the two dt

part_b.fit_converged: fit_material must report converged at tolerance 1e-3 (normalized rms)

part_c.note: so that the ADE time error is negligible against the 0.01 slab limits

acceptance.source_of_limits: completion_gates.json proposed_thresholds slab_R_T_absolute_error and phase_error_radians_on_predeclared_supported_signal_band; the absorption limit and the part-c budgets are this case's own pre-declared limits

notes: Harness shakedown before the recorded run adopted the three-cycle pulse and 400 fs of G3-02 for uniformity and lengthened the driven-cell settling to 32768 steps (the slowest pole, gamma 1e14 /s, needs 0.5 ps to decay below 1e-10). No limit changed. The h10 instances of part a run only when TORCHFDTD_G3_FINE=1; the recorded run sets it. Existing coverage: tests/test_materials.py::test_discrete_constitutive_response (driven cell at 1/(64 dt)).
